core_obligations: Subgroup scheme (proof lines 1243-1261): G^0 with its canonical structure (04PX); e factors through it; the inversion automorphism fixes G^0; G^0 is geometrically connected (056R), so G^0 x_k G^0 is connected (0385) and m(G^0 x G^0) subset G^0 set-theoretically; 04PW factors m through the flat closed immersion, and 0G8L concludes G^0 is a closed subgroup scheme (flat by 04PX).

Irreducibility properties (proof lines 1261-1266): connected group schemes over a field are irreducible (0B7Q), the component through e is geometrically irreducible (047M), and irreducible group schemes over a field are quasi-compact (0B7P).

Prove the subgroup property via geometric connectedness and the factorization lemma (proof lines 1252-1261).
Conclude the three irreducibility/quasi-compactness properties (proof lines 1261-1266).
